tasks.title: Record a walk-in enquiry
tasks.goal: Record an in-person enquiry so it can be followed up or booked.
tasks.before: Have the caller or representative details, the intended client and the clinic ready.
tasks.success: One contact records the enquiry and its clinic. An enquiry does not require a booking.
tasks.trouble: If Walk-in is not available, ask the administrator to check the configured channels. Do not substitute an unrelated live channel.
tasks.title_vi: Ghi nhận khách đến trực tiếp
steps: Open carejiox.com and sign in with your own account. Expand CRM in the left menu and open Contacts.
Choose New Contact. Select Walk-in as the contact channel.
Enter the details requested on the form. If the person is a representative, identify the client separately; use an existing client record where appropriate.
Choose the correct clinic and record the service interest or condition information supplied by the caller. Complete the required fields.
Save the contact. Return to Contacts and search for the entry using the caller details.
Open the saved entry and confirm that Walk-in and the intended clinic are retained. Continue to Book only if a visit is agreed.
search_phrases: Record a walk-in enquiry
Ghi nhận khách đến trực tiếp

tasks.title: Record a junk call
tasks.goal: Keep a record of a junk call without inventing a client or a condition.
tasks.before: Have the incoming phone number if it is available.
tasks.success: The call is retained as junk without a booking.
tasks.trouble: If saving is blocked, read the required-field message and ask the administrator whether the rule should apply to junk calls. Do not enter made-up patient information.
tasks.title_vi: Ghi nhận cuộc gọi rác
steps: Open CRM › Contacts and choose New Contact.
Enter the phone number supplied by the call. Leave the client name and condition blank when they are genuinely unknown.
Use the junk action shown on the new-contact form. Do not create a booking for the call.
Return to Contacts and open the Spam tab.
Find the call by its phone number and reopen it.
Check that the number is saved and that Client Details does not contain an invented name, condition or service.
search_phrases: Record a junk call
Ghi nhận cuộc gọi rác

tasks.title: Save an enquiry without a booking
tasks.goal: Keep the caller information and service interest while the client is deciding.
tasks.before: Identify whether the caller is the client or a representative.
tasks.success: The enquiry remains available for follow-up without creating a visit.
tasks.trouble: If a caller asks for several dates, record the enquiry once and use the booking process for each date. A later separate enquiry gets its own contact.
tasks.title_vi: Lưu yêu cầu chưa đặt lịch
steps: Open CRM › Contacts › New Contact.
Enter the caller name and phone number and identify their relationship to the client.
Find and link the existing client if this enquiry concerns someone already registered. Check identity before selecting a similarly named person.
Select the condition or service interest described by the caller and the correct clinic. Fill in all required fields.
Save or Create Contact. Do not choose Book while no appointment has been agreed.
Return to the Contacts list and search for the entry.
Reopen it. Read back the contact details and service interest and confirm that there is no booking.
search_phrases: Save an enquiry without a booking
Lưu yêu cầu chưa đặt lịch

tasks.title: Schedule a follow-up
tasks.goal: Record when to contact the person again and why.
tasks.before: Open the correct enquiry and agree a callback time with the caller.
tasks.success: The enquiry retains the planned callback information.
tasks.trouble: If the time appears wrong, check your profile time zone before changing the callback.
tasks.title_vi: Lên lịch liên hệ lại
steps: Open CRM › Contacts and find the enquiry by caller details.
Open the record and verify the linked client.
Set the outcome to Pending Follow-up.
Enter the next follow-up date and time in Vietnam local time. Add a short note explaining the next action.
Save the record and return to the list.
Reopen it and check the outcome, date, time and note.
When the follow-up is performed, record its outcome using either the booking or no-booking procedure.
search_phrases: Schedule a follow-up
Lên lịch liên hệ lại

tasks.title: Close a follow-up without a booking
tasks.goal: Record that the enquiry ended without an appointment.
tasks.before: Complete the follow-up conversation and obtain the reason the client is not proceeding.
tasks.success: The enquiry is closed with a reason and remains in its history.
tasks.trouble: If the client wants a later callback rather than closing, use Pending Follow-up instead. If a booking already exists, closing the enquiry is not the booking-cancellation process.
tasks.title_vi: Đóng yêu cầu không đặt lịch
steps: Find the enquiry in CRM › Contacts and open it.
Verify the caller and linked client to avoid closing another enquiry.
Change the outcome to Booking Lost.
Enter a clear reason reflecting the conversation. Do not replace a specific reason with a placeholder note.
Save the change.
Open the Lost tab in Contacts and find the enquiry.
Reopen it and check the outcome, reason and history. Confirm that no visit was created by this action.
search_phrases: Close a follow-up without a booking
Đóng yêu cầu không đặt lịch

tasks.title: Turn an enquiry into a booking
tasks.role: CRM / Operations Manager with booking access
tasks.goal: Book a visit while preserving the link to the original enquiry.
tasks.before: Have the client identity, service, clinic or home location, duration and agreed date ready.
tasks.success: The booking and contact link to each other and to the correct client.
tasks.trouble: If you cannot book with your role, pass the contact reference to the Operations Manager. If a save appears slow, search for the new booking before retrying.
tasks.title_vi: Chuyển yêu cầu thành lịch hẹn
steps: Open the enquiry in CRM › Contacts. If a relative is calling, verify the representative and linked client separately.
If needed, use the client lookup to link the existing client. Do not create a duplicate client for a new caller.
Choose Book on the enquiry.
Select the visit type, facility, service location and duration. Add each requested service with the appropriate quantity or units.
Choose the agreed date and a suitable available time. Check the displayed time and clinic before continuing.
Review the booking information and create the booking once. Record its booking reference.
Open the booking and check its client, date and time. Use Quick actions › Lead Dashboard to return to the originating contact.
Confirm that the contact shows Service Booked and the follow-up is resolved. Its history should show the booking.
search_phrases: Turn an enquiry into a booking
Chuyển yêu cầu thành lịch hẹn

tasks.title: Sell and use a prepaid package
tasks.role: Owner for templates; Operations Manager and assigned nurse for use
tasks.goal: Track a purchased package and how completed or cancelled visits affect its balance.
tasks.before: Use an approved package template. Confirm its services, location, visit count, price and payment policy.
tasks.success: Package usage follows the linked visits; a cancelled reservation is released.
tasks.trouble: A package balance is not proof of cash reconciliation. Check the package invoice and Collections if cash is still awaiting hand-in. Ask Finance to investigate discrepancies before selling a replacement package.
tasks.title_vi: Bán và sử dụng gói trả trước
steps: Owner: open Settings › Master Data › Package Templates. Create or review the approved template and save its visit count, visit type, location and price.
Operations Manager: open Operations › Clients, find the client and choose Quick actions › Buy a package.
Choose the correct template. Review the package details, create its invoice and record payment through the permitted workflow. Check the invoice and collection status separately.
Open Quick actions › Packages on the client and review the package balance.
Create a new booking for an eligible package visit, choosing payment from the package. Check the service and clinic and assign staff.
The assigned nurse accepts, starts and completes the visit in the nurse app, including required notes and closing answers.
Return to the client package and check usage against that completed visit.
If another reserved package visit is cancelled, use More › Cancel Booking on that booking with a reason. Recheck the package to confirm the reservation is released.
For the three-visit example, one completed visit and one cancelled reserved visit leave two visits available.
tasks.warning: Use the current approved package template and check the package balance separately from payment status.
search_phrases: Sell and use a prepaid package
Bán và sử dụng gói trả trước

tasks.title: Book one visit or several dates
tasks.goal: Create one booking for each agreed date without duplicates.
tasks.before: Start with the enquiry and the correct existing or new client.
tasks.success: Every agreed date appears once and remains linked to the enquiry.
tasks.trouble: If a booking seems missing, clear filters and check the time range before creating another. If staff are unavailable, agree an alternative time rather than creating overlapping assignments.
tasks.title_vi: Đặt một hoặc nhiều lịch hẹn
steps: Open CRM › Contacts, find the enquiry and choose Book.
Select the visit type, clinic or home location, duration and services. Verify quantities and the client.
Choose the first agreed date and time. Check the slot actually offered by the scheduler; it may differ from a requested starting time.
Review the information and create the first booking once.
For an additional date, choose Create Another. Recheck the service, facility and duration, then select the next date and time.
Repeat Create Another for each remaining agreed date. Keep each booking reference.
Open Operations › Bookings in list view and search for the client. Set a date range that includes every new visit.
Open each booking and verify its date, time and duration. Use Quick actions › Lead Dashboard to check the originating contact.
search_phrases: Book one visit or several dates
Đặt một hoặc nhiều lịch hẹn

tasks.title: Review client and representative details
tasks.goal: Keep the client identity and relationships consistent across repeat visits.
tasks.before: Use the client details supplied through the clinic’s normal identification process.
tasks.success: One client record holds the correct personal details and the relevant relationships.
tasks.trouble: Do not make a second client just because a different relative called. If two client records already exist, ask an authorised administrator to review them before changing links.
tasks.title_vi: Kiểm tra thông tin khách hàng và người đại diện
steps: Open Operations › Clients and search for the person.
Open the correct client after checking identifying details, rather than relying on the name alone.
Review the identity and contact information. Where multiple phone numbers are supplied, verify the appropriate fields.
Review People for the designated contact person.
Review Healthcare Relationships for the caregiver and referrer, where present.
Open the Bookings tab and select a current or previous visit.
Confirm that the booking points to this same client record. Repeat for a repeat booking if resolving an identity issue.
If a correction is needed, make it only within your permissions, save, and reopen the client to confirm it was retained.
search_phrases: Review client and representative details
Kiểm tra thông tin khách hàng và người đại diện

tasks.title: Add a service during a visit
tasks.role: Assigned nurse or doctor; Operations Manager reviews
tasks.goal: Record an additional service and its units so the saved quote reflects the work.
tasks.before: Any clinical decision follows the clinic’s clinical process.
tasks.success: The additional service appears with the correct units and price alongside the original service.
tasks.trouble: If a service is missing from the selector, do not substitute a similarly named item. Ask the Operations Manager to check the service catalogue and catchment.
tasks.title_vi: Thêm dịch vụ trong buổi chăm sóc
steps: In the nurse app, open the assigned visit and verify the client and booking time.
Accept the offer if it has not been accepted and use Start Service when the visit actually begins.
Choose Add service and select the service that was provided. Verify the exact service and units or quantity.
Save the addition. Add the required clinical note through Clinical Notes › Add New Clinical Note, then confirm and save.
Open View service and check that the original and additional lines are present.
Review the updated total with the client through the permitted quote workflow before completing the visit.
In the office, open the same booking in Operations › Bookings and select Pricing.
Check both service lines and the recalculated total. Use Quick actions › View Quote to inspect the saved quote.
search_phrases: Add a service during a visit
Thêm dịch vụ trong buổi chăm sóc

tasks.title: Review a quote and invoice
tasks.role: Operations Manager for the booking; Finance for invoicing
tasks.goal: Confirm that services and approved pricing flow through to the invoice.
tasks.before: Have the booking reference and the current approved price rules. Use the worked examples to understand the calculation, then check the current clinic price list for actual work.
tasks.success: The invoice matches the approved services and quote, with a separately understood payment balance.
tasks.trouble: Review the price inputs before changing a price rule.
tasks.title_vi: Kiểm tra báo giá và hóa đơn
steps: Open Operations › Bookings and find the booking.
Open Pricing and read each service line. Check service code, quantity or units, base price and any additional charges.
Check the inputs that affect price: catchment, clinic or home, date and time, distance, duration and approved discount.
If a discount is entered through View Quote, record its reason and review the resulting total before saving.
Check parking or staff reimbursement separately. In these worked examples parking is not a customer invoice line.
Open Quick actions › View Invoice, or Execution › Quote & Invoice when shown on the booking.
Compare the invoice client, booking reference, service lines, discount, tax and total with the saved quote.
Check the invoice status and balance separately; the invoice total does not tell you whether the client has paid.
If any line is unexpected, retain the booking and invoice references and ask Finance or the pricing administrator to investigate before posting or collecting.
tasks.warning: Use the approved tariff and tax settings for the actual visit. The invoice total and the remaining balance are different values.
search_phrases: Review a quote and invoice
Kiểm tra báo giá và hóa đơn

tasks.title: Handle new and repeat enquiries
tasks.goal: Keep a separate contact for each new enquiry while retaining the same client.
tasks.before: Establish who is calling and who needs care.
tasks.success: One client can have multiple enquiries; each enquiry can lead to one or more bookings.
tasks.trouble: Do not overwrite an old enquiry to represent a new call. If a booking is linked incorrectly, ask an authorised user to review the record history before correcting it.
tasks.title_vi: Xử lý yêu cầu mới và yêu cầu lặp lại
steps: For a new enquiry, open CRM › Contacts › New Contact even when the client has used the clinic before.
If the caller is the client, record that relationship. If the caller is a relative, record the caller and link the existing client separately.
Search the existing clients carefully before allowing a new client to be created.
Choose Book from this new contact and enter the agreed visit details.
Use Create Another if this single enquiry requests several visit dates.
Open each new booking and use Quick actions › Lead Dashboard to confirm that it links to this enquiry.
Open an older booking for the same client when checking continuity. It should still link to its own earlier contact.
Open Operations › Clients › Bookings and confirm the old and new visits belong to the same client.
search_phrases: Handle new and repeat enquiries
Xử lý yêu cầu mới và yêu cầu lặp lại

tasks.title: Assign a care team
tasks.goal: Offer the booking to the appropriate staff and identify the lead.
tasks.before: Use a saved booking in your catchment. Confirm staff suitability and availability.
tasks.success: The booking care team and assignment records agree.
tasks.trouble: If the correct staff member is unavailable or absent from the list, check catchment, staff setup and schedule with the administrator. Do not bypass an availability restriction.
tasks.title_vi: Phân công nhóm chăm sóc
steps: Open the booking in Operations › Bookings and verify its client, location and time.
Choose Assign Staff from the next-step action. The staff schedule opens for this booking.
Where using the list workflow, switch to list view and choose New to create an assignment.
Select the nurse and choose Lead Staff when this person is the lead. Save the assignment.
If a doctor is also required, add another assignment, select the doctor and choose Doctor. Save.
Reopen the booking and review Overview › Care team.
Choose Quick actions › View Assignments and compare the staff and roles with the intended team.
Ask the assigned person to check the notification in the nurse app.
search_phrases: Assign a care team
Phân công nhóm chăm sóc

tasks.title: Accept an assignment
tasks.role: Assigned nurse or doctor; Operations Manager monitors
tasks.goal: Confirm that you can perform an offered visit.
tasks.before: Review the offered date, time, location and service before accepting.
tasks.success: The assignment remains accepted and is visible to the office.
tasks.trouble: If you cannot attend, decline rather than accepting and leaving the office unaware. If the result is unclear, reload and confirm status before retrying.
tasks.title_vi: Chấp nhận phân công
steps: Sign in to the nurse app with your own staff account.
Open the notifications bell and find the offer for the booking.
Verify the booking reference and visit details.
Choose Accept once.
Return to your day view and open the visit to confirm it appears in your schedule.
Operations Manager: reopen the booking in Operations › Bookings.
Check that the booking shows Assigned and Staff Confirmed, then review Quick actions › View Assignments.
Open the assignment history if you need to confirm who accepted and when.
search_phrases: Accept an assignment
Chấp nhận phân công

tasks.title: Reassign a declined visit
tasks.before: Confirm that replacement staff are suitable and available for this booking.
tasks.success: The decline is retained in history and the replacement accepts the visit.
tasks.trouble: If both people appear active unexpectedly, stop and review the assignment records. A second offer is not proof that the first active assignment has been removed.
tasks.title_vi: Phân công lại lịch hẹn bị từ chối
steps: Assigned staff: open the offer through the nurse-app notification and choose Decline if you cannot attend.
Operations Manager: open the same booking and choose Quick actions › View Assignments.
Review the declined assignment and its history to confirm the staff response.
Return to the booking and choose Assign Staff. Add the suitable replacement with the appropriate role.
The replacement signs in to their own nurse-app account, opens the notification and reviews the offer.
The replacement chooses Accept.
Operations Manager: reopen Overview › Care team and View Assignments.
Check that the active assignment reflects the intended replacement and that the declined person has not remained incorrectly active.
search_phrases: Reassign a declined visit
Phân công lại lịch hẹn bị từ chối

tasks.title: Cancel a booking with a reason
tasks.goal: Record an agreed cancellation without losing its reason or history.
tasks.before: Verify the exact booking and the client’s cancellation request. Consider package and billing consequences.
tasks.success: The booking is cancelled and the reason and history remain visible.
tasks.trouble: Cancelling a visit is not the same as cancelling a posted charge or refunding cash. Do not assume that all billing has been reversed.
tasks.title_vi: Hủy lịch hẹn kèm lý do
steps: Open Operations › Bookings and search for the booking reference.
Confirm the client, date and time before choosing a cancellation action.
Open More › Cancel Booking.
Choose the appropriate reason. If using Other, enter a clear explanatory note.
Read the confirmation and confirm only when this booking should actually be cancelled.
Return to the bookings list and reopen the same reference.
Open the Cancellation tab and check the reason, note, user and timestamp.
If the visit used a package, recheck the available balance. If an invoice or payment already exists, ask Finance to handle that separately.
search_phrases: Cancel a booking with a reason
Hủy lịch hẹn kèm lý do

tasks.title: Reschedule a visit and change staff
tasks.goal: Move an existing booking while retaining its history.
tasks.before: Agree the replacement time and confirm staff availability.
tasks.success: The existing booking has the new time and intended staff, with a history of the change.
tasks.trouble: If an offered time is unavailable, agree another time. Do not create a second booking as a workaround unless the original is deliberately handled to avoid duplicates.
tasks.title_vi: Đổi lịch hẹn và nhân viên
steps: Open the booking and confirm the client and current date and time.
Choose Reschedule.
Enter the new date and time using Vietnam local time.
If the original person cannot attend, select the appropriate replacement staff.
Review the new schedule and staff before confirming Reschedule.
Reopen the booking from Operations › Bookings.
Check the new date and time and review Overview › Care team.
Open Activity to read the change history, then Quick actions › View Assignments to confirm the active assignment.
Check pricing again when the move crosses a weekday, after-hours period or holiday.
search_phrases: Reschedule a visit and change staff
Đổi lịch hẹn và nhân viên
move an appointment
change booking date
doi lich hen
reschedule
đổi lịch

tasks.title: Find your assigned visits
tasks.goal: See the visits allocated to you for the selected day.
tasks.before: Use your own staff login and check the selected date.
tasks.success: Your own assigned visits appear; unassigned visits and other staff’s visits are not your work list.
tasks.trouble: An empty day does not necessarily mean no bookings exist at the clinic. Check assignment and date rather than trying another person’s login.
tasks.title_vi: Tìm lịch hẹn được phân công
steps: Open https://carejiox.com/health_pwa in the phone browser or your installed nurse app.
Sign in with the account provided by your administrator. Do not use another person’s account.
Open the Booking tab and choose Day.
Use Today, the date picker or the previous and next date controls to select the visit day.
Review the visit cards, including time, client and status.
Open the notifications bell to review new offers and respond to them.
Open a visit card to review the details before travelling.
If the expected visit is missing, confirm the day and ask the Operations Manager to check your assignment and catchment.
search_phrases: Find your assigned visits
Tìm lịch hẹn được phân công

tasks.title: Review a visit before attending
tasks.goal: Confirm where to go, when to attend and what is booked.
tasks.before: Have accepted the appropriate offer and selected the correct day.
tasks.success: The displayed client, location, time and services are understood before the visit.
tasks.trouble: If the location or services are wrong, ask the office to correct the booking. Viewing the details does not authorise a clinical treatment.
tasks.title_vi: Kiểm tra thông tin trước buổi chăm sóc
steps: Open the Booking day view and select the visit.
Check the client name and identifier against the intended booking.
Read the scheduled date, time and duration.
Review the address or clinic and whether the service is at home or at the clinic.
Read the service list and each quantity or unit. Do not infer units from a similar service name.
Check the contact details and relevant instructions supplied for the visit.
If the details differ from what you were told, contact the office and resolve the discrepancy before starting.
Return to the day view when finished reviewing.
search_phrases: Review a visit before attending
Kiểm tra thông tin trước buổi chăm sóc

tasks.title: Open and return to the correct visit
tasks.goal: Avoid entering information against the wrong appointment.
tasks.before: Use the correct date in the Booking view.
tasks.success: The selected visit opens consistently, including after a refresh.
tasks.trouble: When two visits have the same client name, use the time and reference to distinguish them. Never assume that the last open visit is still selected.
tasks.title_vi: Mở đúng lịch hẹn
steps: Find the visit by its client and scheduled time, checking the reference if the person has several visits.
Tap the visit card to open it.
Verify the client and time again in the detail view before making any change.
Return to the day list when you need a different visit.
If the app has been refreshed or reopened, select the date again and open the intended visit.
Confirm that you are back on the same booking before adding a note or starting service.
search_phrases: Open and return to the correct visit
Mở đúng lịch hẹn

tasks.title: Start a visit
tasks.goal: Record the actual start of the service.
tasks.before: Be at the visit and ready to begin, with the correct booking accepted.
tasks.success: The visit is In Progress and the office can see the actual start.
tasks.trouble: Do not start a visit just to test the button on a live booking. If the start time is wrong, report the booking reference and observed time to the Operations Manager.
tasks.title_vi: Bắt đầu dịch vụ
steps: Open the assigned visit in the nurse app.
Verify the client, time and services before starting.
Tap Start Service once when the service begins.
Check that the status changes to In Progress and the timer or start indicator appears.
If you leave and return to the visit, confirm it still shows In Progress.
Operations Manager: open the same booking and check Execution for the actual start time.
If no saved start is visible, refresh and investigate the connection or assignment before attempting another action.
search_phrases: Start a visit
Bắt đầu dịch vụ

tasks.title: Write and save a clinical note
tasks.goal: Record the note in the correct visit and confirm it is retained.
tasks.before: Use a visit you are authorised to document. Follow the clinic’s documentation requirements.
tasks.success: The note is retained on the visit and visible to authorised office staff.
tasks.trouble: If the note is absent after reopening the visit, restore the connection and confirm whether it was saved before entering another note.
tasks.title_vi: Nhập và lưu ghi chú lâm sàng
steps: Open the correct visit in progress and confirm the client.
Choose Clinical Notes › Add New Clinical Note.
Enter an accurate account of the service and observations in the available fields. Use your clinical knowledge and clinic policy for the content.
Choose Confirm and Save as shown in the example workflow.
Close the note panel, leave the visit and reopen it.
Open Clinical Notes again and confirm your note is present and complete.
An authorised office user can open the same booking and review the Clinical tab.
If the saved note is missing, check the connection and report the problem before entering a duplicate.
search_phrases: Write and save a clinical note
Nhập và lưu ghi chú lâm sàng

tasks.title: Answer the visit closing questions
tasks.goal: Save the agreed follow-up outcome before closing the visit.
tasks.before: Finish documenting the work, including services, quantities and notes.
tasks.success: The required closing answers are saved and incomplete answers cannot be submitted.
tasks.trouble: If Submit is blocked, read the field message and complete the reason or other required answer. Do not bypass the closing questions with an arbitrary choice.
tasks.title_vi: Trả lời câu hỏi kết thúc dịch vụ
steps: Open the visit in progress and choose View service.
Review the service lines and total with the client. Enter the required confirmation note and Save Quote.
Select the appropriate payment choice based on what actually happened. Choose Create Invoice Now only when the invoice should be created.
Choose Complete Service to open the closing questions.
Record whether another appointment is wanted, already exists or is not wanted, following the options shown.
If no further appointment is wanted, select the required reason. If choosing Other, explain it in the note.
Set Need to Follow up only when a follow-up is actually required. Review the answers and Submit.
If an existing later appointment is offered for change, retain it when that is the intended outcome; do not accidentally cancel the client’s existing visit.
Office: check the booking Overview › Visit close card and the client record for the saved answers.
search_phrases: Answer the visit closing questions
Trả lời câu hỏi kết thúc dịch vụ

tasks.title: Finish a visit and confirm completion
tasks.goal: Close the service and verify its final state.
tasks.before: The visit must be in progress. Review services, notes, quote, payment choice and closing questions first.
tasks.success: The visit remains Completed with start and end times recorded.
tasks.trouble: If completion is blocked, inspect the required closing fields. If the app and office disagree after refreshing, report the booking reference and avoid repeated invoice creation.
tasks.title_vi: Hoàn tất và kiểm tra buổi chăm sóc
steps: Open the visit and verify the client and booking time.
Complete the service review, required notes and payment choices using the closing procedure in the related guide.
Choose Complete Service and submit all required closing answers.
Wait for the save result. Return to the day list and check the visit status.
Reopen the visit and confirm Completed.
If you refresh the app, confirm that it remains Completed; do not submit completion a second time when the first save succeeded.
Operations Manager: open the booking and check Execution for actual start and end times.
Review any linked invoice through the invoicing procedure rather than assuming that Completed means Paid.
search_phrases: Finish a visit and confirm completion
Hoàn tất và kiểm tra buổi chăm sóc

tasks.title: Check the invoice created at completion
tasks.role: Assigned staff completes; Finance or authorised office user verifies
tasks.goal: Confirm that a completed visit produced the intended invoice once.
tasks.before: Choose Create Invoice Now in the completion workflow only when appropriate.
tasks.success: The invoice is linked to the correct visit and agrees with its saved quote.
tasks.trouble: If there is no invoice, check whether invoice creation was requested before creating one manually. If duplicates exist, ask Finance to review their status before cancelling anything.
tasks.title_vi: Kiểm tra hóa đơn sau khi hoàn tất
steps: Complete the visit using the service review and closing-question procedure.
An authorised office user opens Operations › Bookings and finds the visit.
Open Execution › Quote & Invoice and follow the linked invoice.
Check the invoice client and booking reference.
Review the service lines, quantities, discount, tax and total against the saved quote.
Open Finance › Invoices and search for the client or invoice reference.
Check that the intended booking has one invoice rather than a duplicate created by repeated completion attempts.
Review payment status separately and route an unpaid invoice to the usual collection process.
search_phrases: Check the invoice created at completion
Kiểm tra hóa đơn sau khi hoàn tất

tasks.title: Issue an invoice and review money owed
tasks.role: Assigned staff initiates; Finance or authorised Owner reviews
tasks.goal: Understand how an unpaid posted invoice appears in receivables.
tasks.before: Use the approved services and quote. Check whether the client will pay now or later.
tasks.success: The unpaid posted invoice is reflected in the client’s outstanding amount.
tasks.trouble: The client’s total balance may include several invoices. Compare the individual invoice first before expecting the whole client balance to equal one visit.
tasks.title_vi: Xuất hóa đơn và kiểm tra công nợ
steps: At visit completion, review View service and the quote with the client. Apply only an authorised discount and record its reason.
Save the quote and choose Pay Later if the client has not paid. Choose Create Invoice Now when appropriate.
Complete the service and required closing questions.
Finance or an authorised Owner: find the booking and open Execution › Quote & Invoice.
Open the linked invoice and check client, service lines, discount, tax, total and posting status.
Open Finance › Receivables and find the client.
Review the outstanding balance and use AR Transactions to inspect the linked receivable entry.
Use the invoice reference to distinguish this charge from other visits for the same client.

tasks.title: Record cash paid at the visit
tasks.role: Assigned nurse or doctor; Finance verifies
tasks.goal: Record payment accurately and retain the cash custody trail.
tasks.before: Count the cash actually received and confirm the amount due for this visit.
tasks.success: For a full payment, the example invoice is paid with zero remaining balance, while the cash custody record remains traceable.
tasks.trouble: If the amount is less than the invoice, use the appropriate part-payment process and check the residual amount. Do not mark full payment when cash was not received.
tasks.title_vi: Ghi nhận tiền mặt tại buổi chăm sóc
steps: Open the correct visit and review View service with the client.
Confirm the services and total, enter the required review note and Save Quote.
In the payment step, choose Pay Now and Cash.
Enter or confirm the amount actually received. Check it against the amount due before proceeding.
Choose Create Invoice Now when required and complete the service with the closing answers.
Finance or an authorised Owner: open the linked invoice and check its status and remaining balance.
Open the linked payment and verify the cash amount, method and visit.
Review Finance › Payments to identify the cash held by the collecting staff member.
Hand the cash to the designated receiver through the Collections procedure; payment by the client and cash hand-in are separate events.

tasks.title: Receive cash handed in by staff
tasks.goal: Record custody of cash already collected from a client.
tasks.before: Match the physical cash to the staff payment record and count it before confirmation.
tasks.success: The cash handover is recorded once with the receiver and receipt, without double-counting client payment.
tasks.trouble: If the cash differs, do not tick Amount Verified. Record and resolve the discrepancy with the collecting staff member and Finance before confirming.
tasks.title_vi: Nhận tiền mặt bàn giao từ nhân viên
steps: Open Operations › Collections › Pending Delivery.
Open the payment being handed in. Verify staff, client, amount and reference.
Use View Invoice to check the linked invoice and its current balance.
Choose Mark Cash Delivered to OM.
Check the named receiver. Count the physical money and select Amount Verified only if it matches.

Review Auto-Reconcile and bank-deposit options. In the example Auto-Reconcile is off because the payment is already matched, and no bank deposit is being made. Use the clinic’s approved setting for the actual situation.
Choose Confirm Cash Receipt once.
Reopen the invoice to confirm that recording custody has not created a second client payment.
Review the cash record and, with permission, Receivables › AR Transactions › Cash Hand-ins for the receiver, time and handover receipt.

tasks.title: Receive a part payment after a visit
tasks.goal: Apply the amount received and keep the remaining balance visible.
tasks.before: Have the invoice reference, amount received, payment date and correct cash or bank journal.

Enter the amount actually received and the applicable payment details. Do not replace a part payment with the full invoice total.

Reopen the invoice and review payment status and remaining amount.
Open the linked payment to confirm the amount and journal.
Return to Finance › Receivables and confirm that the client’s balance has reduced by this payment.

tasks.title: Choose a credit note or a cash refund
tasks.goal: Distinguish cancelling a charge from giving back money that was paid.
tasks.before: Confirm the business reason and obtain the clinic’s approval for the correct accounting action.
tasks.success: A credit note reverses a charge; a payment refund returns money and can reopen the amount due.
tasks.trouble: If the client is shown as owing money after a cash refund, check whether the charge was meant to remain valid. Do not create an unrelated adjustment to hide the balance.
tasks.title_vi: Chọn chứng từ giảm trừ hoặc hoàn tiền

Enter the reason, choose Reverse and review the credit note.
Confirm the credit note only after verifying its client, amount and linked original invoice. Reopen the original invoice and check the remaining balance.
For the separate cash-return example: open the paid invoice and identify its linked cash payment.
Open that payment in Finance › Payments and choose Create Refund using the approved refund details.
Review the invoice again. In the cash-refund flow, returning the payment makes the invoice owed again.
Check Receivables and AR Transactions to understand the resulting balance and trace the related documents.
tasks.warning: Ask Finance to confirm whether the charge is being cancelled, money is being returned, or both. Apply the approved process for that intention.

Return to the filtered list and confirm the export scope.

tasks.title: Add or disable a user
tasks.goal: Give a staff member their own access with the correct job and catchment.
tasks.before: Have the approved job, area, facility and staff linkage. Deliver initial credentials privately.
tasks.success: The person has their own login and the intended access.
tasks.trouble: If the user sees the wrong menus or catchment, review their role and employee linkage. Do not give Owner access merely to work around a missing permission.

Select the approved job, area and base facility. Review any required staff or employee linkage.
Review the information and choose Add them.
Open Users & Roles and find the new user to confirm the role and area.
Have the person sign in with their own login and verify their name in My Preferences and their intended menus.
If the account is only a temporary temporary account or access is being withdrawn, an authorised administrator can find it in Users & Roles and choose Switch off.
Keep the account’s business history; disabling access is different from deleting records.
tasks.warning: Share initial credentials privately. Disable an account only when access should end.

tasks.title: Understand roles and permitted work

tasks.title_vi: Hiểu vai trò và quyền làm việc

tasks.title: Work within your catchment

tasks.before: Confirm your assigned catchment with the administrator.

operations.question: A visit moves to a different day. What should you check?
options: The new time, active staff assignment, history and pricing conditions
Create a second visit and leave the old one active
operations.explanation: Reschedule the existing visit and check staff, history and any changed pricing conditions.

crm.question: A relative calls again for an existing client. What should you do?
options: Create a new client for every enquiry
Create a new contact and link the existing client
crm.explanation: A new enquiry has its own contact. The same client record can have several contacts and bookings.

clinical.question: When should you use Start Service?
clinical.explanation: Accepting confirms the assignment; Start Service records the actual beginning of the visit.

finance.question: A client pays 80,000 VND against a 180,000 VND invoice. What should remain due?
finance.explanation: Record only the money received. The unpaid remainder is 100,000 VND.

owner.question: A staff member needs access to their assigned catchment. What is the correct approach?
options: Review the approved job, catchment and staff linkage
owner.explanation: Use individual accounts and the approved role and catchment; do not widen access to bypass a problem.
